claims.exact_statement: For every finite disjoint product f of genuine Boolean factors on at most four physical variables, G(f)<=11I(f)/4. The class is restriction closed and 11/4 is sharp.
claims.first_unproved_line: No extension from bounded factors to arbitrary coherent high-arity supports is supplied.

claims.exact_statement: The restriction-closed tensor class generated by signed coordinate-permuted clique-quadratic phases (-1)^[sum_{i<j}x_ix_j+epsilon sum_i x_i] satisfies G(f)<=3I(f) in every dimension; 3 is the sharp supremum.
hypotheses: finite disjoint products of clique-quadratic blocks
proof_dependencies: flat Walsh law for nonsingular quadratic phases
claims.first_unproved_line: Changing coherent unions of multiple plateaued supports are outside the class.

claims.exact_statement: For any quadratic bent Boolean phase on even n with inverse polar-matrix row weights r_i, U=I=n/2 and G=sum_i(3/2-2^{-r_i}), hence G/I=3-(2/n)sum_i2^{-r_i}<3.
claims.first_unproved_line: Restriction closure of all quadratic bent phases requires a theorem for arbitrary plateaued quadratic restrictions; only the clique subclass is closed here.
